question: Prepare BTK kinase domain complexed with ibrutinib from the 5P9J crystal structure and compute the PM6 QM/MM energy in its pocket. Explain the Cys481 covalent binding, Met477 hinge hydrogen bond, and setup choices.

literature_contacts.MET477: hinge backbone NH to pyrazolopyrimidine N
literature_contacts.GLU475: hinge backbone NH to pyrazolopyrimidine amino group
literature_contacts.CYS481: catalytic Cys481 SG covalent attachment to CAA

literature_source: Bender et al. 2017, Mol Pharmacol 91:208; PDB 5P9J, 1.08 Å crystal structure of BTK in complex with ibrutinib
